name: clock-73h-ahead
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile with the pump's clock set 73 hours ahead on its screen 180 minutes ago (TimeChanged and DateChange): it ends 73 hours ahead of the phone, past the 24 hours TandemKit trusts, so the app has to set it. Before it, a 2.0 U pump bolus 240 minutes ago and a 150% temp rate from 200 minutes ago that ends after the change; after it, a 1.0 U pump bolus 90 minutes ago, so the records either side of the change are stamped on different clocks.
